title: cornutia odorata
intro: Cornutia odorata, commonly known as the fragrant cornutia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Lamiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the fragrant cornutia include wound healing, pain relief, and the management of digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
